meta.title: x/tools/gopls: gopls restart needed after changing build tags
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@a2a24778ba95 (gopls/internal/regtest: externalize shouldLoad tracking; CL 417576, named as the fix by the maintainer in the thread); the closing commit 310ea71b7 (CL 420537) only adds the regression test TestIgnoreFile
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with the local Go (go1.27.1), which builds both; the server runs the local go command. v0.9.1 was tagged 2022-07-13, CL 417576 merged 2022-07-22, v0.9.2 was tagged 2022-08-08 (its x/tools commit contains a2a24778b by git ancestry, candidate mapping).
meta.notes: findleyr bisected the fix to CL 417576, which reworked the tracking of packages that need reloading: before it, metadata whose file set changed (a file dropped from the package by a build constraint) was not reloaded, so the duplicate-main error stayed until a restart.

files.note: the go.mod of the fix's regression test TestIgnoreFile (module mod.test, go 1.12); the issue's txtar has none

repro.steps: Open foo.go and bar.go (both declare func main, so the duplicate-main error is reported). Add '//go:build ignore' (and a blank line) at the top of bar.go. Reported: the diagnostic stays until gopls is restarted. Probe: the diagnostics of foo.go after the edit are compared with a fresh session (a restart) on the edited files, and a fresh control.
